baseline: Your tests pass on your csv.hpp

variants.name: trailing-delimiter-lost
variants.label: a trailing delimiter loses the last, empty field ("a," gives only "a")
variants.hint: Think about where a line ends: after the delimiter, there is one more (empty) field.

variants.name: doubled-quote-dropped
variants.label: two quotes inside a quoted field disappear instead of becoming one quote
variants.hint: A quoted field can contain quotes, written twice. Parse one.

variants.name: format-does-not-quote-the-delimiter
variants.label: format_line() does not quote a field that contains the delimiter
variants.hint: What happens if you format a field with a comma in it and parse it back?

variants.name: format-does-not-double-quotes
variants.label: format_line() leaves the quotes inside a field alone
variants.hint: A field that contains a quote must be quoted, and its quote doubled. Check by formatting and parsing back.

variants.name: unterminated-quote-accepted
variants.label: an unclosed quote is accepted instead of raising csv::ParseError
variants.hint: What does the documentation say about a quote that is never closed?

variants.name: text-after-closing-quote-accepted
variants.label: text after a closing quote is accepted instead of raising csv::ParseError
variants.hint: After the closing quote only the delimiter or the end of the line may follow.

variants.name: crlf-leaves-a-carriage-return
variants.label: a Windows line ending (\r\n) leaves a "\r" at the end of the last field
variants.hint: Parse lines that end in "\r\n", for a line and for a document.

variants.name: document-splits-quoted-line-breaks
variants.label: parse_document() ends a record at a line break inside quotes
variants.hint: A quoted field may contain a line break. Parse a document that has one.
